goal: Persist independent daily-summary, local 09:00 summary time and soak reminder choices; derive one complete logical plan from current product data; reconcile stable native registrations on app start, resume, restore, product mutation and Android environment signals while permission denial only disables physical delivery and never hides Today work.
acceptanceCriteria: Product settings and backup/restore preserve independent daily-summary enabled, summary local time defaulting to 09:00, and soak-reminder enabled values with safe fallback for legacy archives/settings.

Production ReminderPlan derives current/overdue Today work, exactly one future daily summary when enabled and useful, and each enabled future soak target from the current persisted ProductSnapshot using stable physical IDs.
Real Android and iOS permission state drives physical scheduling; denied or revoked permission cancels physical registrations while product actions and Today remain unchanged and visible.

Application start, process restart, foreground resume/settings return, successful restore, product-data mutation, Android boot/package replacement/time-zone signals and iOS active-scene transitions invoke idempotent reconciliation without duplicate logical or physical IDs.
Android keeps best-effort alarms without exact-alarm permission; iOS uses pending notification identifiers; both localize native notification text from EN/RU resources.

Platform, component/integration and persistence tests prove no-work silence, one daily summary, independent soak choice, denial behavior, stable IDs, restart/restore idempotence, cancellation and time-zone/environment recovery. Specialist does not run Gradle.
